draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: NVIDIA announced an agreement to buy Hugging Face for about $12.93 billion and promises continued choice; closing and future customer effects are not established by that statement.
causalSequence: Builders find and share trained models on Hugging Face.
Using a model requires computing somewhere; Hugging Face also connects builders to several services that run models.
A platform owner can make some choices easier to discover or integrate than others; this is a possible influence, not an observed restriction.
Compare the stated commitment with practical alternatives, switching effort and applicable terms over time.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A hypothetical video-player maker buys the video shop; customers care about what the shop carries and what equipment works, while the shop does not own every film.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A workplace AI supplier says it offers many models, but one running service; model variety alone does not demonstrate freedom to switch the service.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask a supplier which trained model and running service sit behind the tool, what switching either would involve, and which licence terms apply.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story, The LAiDIES Read, What This Means for You, Cocktail Party Explanation, Class Notes, Sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Keep a short factual opening, one concrete distribution explanation, then evidence to watch and a question useful in a buying or workplace discussion.
